theory.title: Be used to y get used to en entornos nuevos
theory.explanation: Be used to + sustantivo o verbo en -ing significa que algo ya te resulta familiar. Get used to + sustantivo o -ing describe el proceso de acostumbrarse. Used to + infinitivo habla de un hábito o estado del pasado que ha cambiado.
theory.tip: Diferencia entre hábito pasado (used to + infinitivo) y adaptación (be/get used to + -ing).

patterns.pattern: I'm used to hearing different accents now.

patterns.label: Be used to y get used to en entornos nuevos · 2
patterns.pattern: She is getting used to living abroad.
examples:
She is getting used to living abroad.
→ Ella se está acostumbrando a vivir en el extranjero.

patterns.label: Be used to y get used to en entornos nuevos · 3
patterns.pattern: We used to spend summers with our grandparents.

We used to spend summers with our grandparents.
→ Antes pasábamos los veranos con nuestros abuelos.

patterns.pattern: He wasn't used to eating dinner so late.
examples:
He wasn't used to eating dinner so late.
→ Él no estaba acostumbrado a cenar tan tarde.

patterns.label: Be used to y get used to en entornos nuevos · 5
patterns.pattern: They got used to travelling by train.

They got used to travelling by train.
→ Se acostumbraron a viajar en tren.

patterns.pattern: Are you used to speaking English every day?

patterns.pattern: I didn't use to enjoy spicy food.
examples:
I didn't use to enjoy spicy food.
→ Antes no me gustaba la comida picante.

patterns.label: Be used to y get used to en entornos nuevos · 8
patterns.pattern: It took time to get used to the new culture.
examples:
It took time to get used to the new culture.
→ Costó un tiempo acostumbrarse a la nueva cultura.

patterns.label: Be used to y get used to en entornos nuevos · 9
patterns.pattern: My friends are used to working in international teams.
examples:
My friends are used to working in international teams.
→ Mis amigos están acostumbrados a trabajar en equipos internacionales.

patterns.label: Be used to y get used to en entornos nuevos · 10
patterns.pattern: You'll soon get used to the local routine.
examples:
You'll soon get used to the local routine.
→ Pronto te acostumbrarás a la rutina local.

content.passage: When Tom first moved to another country, he found the daily routine confusing. He wasn't used to eating dinner so late or travelling by bus everywhere. At first, he missed the food he used to eat at home. However, he gradually got used to the new culture and became comfortable speaking another language. Now he is used to working with people from several countries.

items.prompt: Describe something you are used to doing every day.
items.modelAnswer: I believe learning about other cultures helps people become more open-minded. When I visit a new place, I try to respect local customs and learn a few useful expressions. At first, some differences may feel unfamiliar, but people can understand one another if they communicate politely. I enjoy meeting local people because we can share experiences and learn from each other. In the future, I hope to take part in more international exchanges.

B: Yes, and they practised the language every day. A: Did they attend the town festival? B: They did. The whole community was involved. A: How did the visitors behave? B: They showed respect and made new friendships.
